priority_policy.primary_visual_rule: Ingredient and nutrition panels are the primary photo proof targets.
priority_policy.secondary_visual_rule: Wrapper fronts and product beauty shots are secondary package context unless readable label text is visible.
priority_policy.capture_rule: For each source era, capture ingredient panel, nutrition panel, wrapper back/side text, net weight, and maker/date cues in that order.
priority_policy.claim_gate: No formulation claim is promoted until a private readable crop is OCRed/transcribed, corrected, manually verified, and attributed.
